name: Jászkarajenő (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Jászkarajenő (a red shield with a white mounted archer on a green base) below the name JÁSZKARAJENŐ in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
